def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    cells=[(i,j,v) for i in range(h) for j,v in enumerate(grid[i]) if v!=0]
    best=None
    for name,keyf in (('-',lambda i,j:(i-j)),('+',lambda i,j:(i+j))):
        for pr in range(1,60):
            f={}; ok=True
            for i,j,v in cells:
                k=keyf(i,j)%pr
                if k in f and f[k]!=v: ok=False; break
                f[k]=v
            if ok and len(f)==pr:
                best=(name,pr,f); break
        if best: break
    name,pr,f=best
    keyf=(lambda i,j:(i-j)) if name=='-' else (lambda i,j:(i+j))
    return [[f[keyf(i,j)%pr] for j in range(w)] for i in range(h)]
'''
